attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-node RabbitMQ cluster (node1/node2/node3, CentOS Stream 10, RabbitMQ 3.13.7 / Erlang 26.2.5.4) serving AMQP exclusively over TLS on port 5671, using a dedicated CA generated on node1. mTLS is enforced (verify_peer, fail_if_no_peer_cert=true) so only clients presenting a certificate issued by that CA can connect; plaintext AMQP (5672) is disabled entirely. The management HTTP API (15672) is reachable only from the cluster's own /24 subnet via a dedicated firewalld zone scoped to that subnet; the node-facing public zone exposes only 5671/tcp. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time with quorum preserved, boot_id changes proved real reboots, and RabbitMQ/cluster/TLS/management-restriction health was re-verified after each.
